title: Yao Lao Is Taken
summary: Medusa, who has broken through a bottleneck, stops Protector Wu from killing Xiao Yan, and Xiao Yan begs her to save Yao Lao instead. Medusa and Yao Lao fight Protector Wu together until he detonates Yun Shan's soul in a darkness called the Funeral of Spirits. Protector Wu captures Yao Lao's soul. Before he goes, Yao Lao leaves Xiao Yan the origin of the Bone Chilling Flame and tells him to show his ring to his old friend Feng Zun Zhe. Protector Wu tells Xiao Yan to come to the Hall of Souls for his master and leaves, and Medusa stops him from chasing. Mad with grief, Xiao Yan turns on the Misty Cloud Sect, and its new leader Yun Yun stands in his way with Nalan Yanran. Yun Yun says she will die rather than see the sect wiped out, and Xiao Yan orders it disbanded within a month.
